content.title: About
content.content: NFS High-Protein Drink is a ready‑to‑drink shake with high protein content, low calories, and a light texture. It is designed to support muscle recovery after workouts and is convenient to use anytime.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink provides 30 g of protein per serving from whey and plant sources.
It includes B‑vitamins and minerals such as calcium and magnesium to support energy metabolism.
The product is gluten‑free, lactose‑free, and contains no artificial sweeteners.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and is fully recyclable.
Each bottle is a single‑serve, making it ideal for travel and sports activities.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Protein promotes muscle growth and repair, supporting protein synthesis after exertion.

items.title: Low calorie count
items.content: A modest calorie load helps maintain energy balance during an active lifestyle.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C and zinc contribute to a strengthened immune system.

items.title: Enhanced recovery
items.content: Fast‑absorbing amino acids accelerate recovery after intense training.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Electrolytes in the drink help maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Whey protein may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with dairy intolerance.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Too much protein can strain the kidneys, especially in people predisposed to kidney issues.

items.title: Artificial sweetener content
items.content: Some versions may contain sucralose or stevia, which are not suitable for everyone.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: High calcium levels can affect the absorption of certain antibiotics and alkaline drugs.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume one ready‑to‑drink shake (250 ml) immediately after training or as a snack between meals. For extra flavor, add fresh berries or a banana.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the drink in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, refrigerate and consume within 24 hours.
